hebrewText: וּ/שְׁמֻע֣וֹת יְבַהֲלֻ֔/הוּ מִ/מִּזְרָ֖ח וּ/מִ/צָּפ֑וֹן וְ/יָצָא֙ בְּ/חֵמָ֣א גְדֹלָ֔ה לְ/הַשְׁמִ֥יד וּֽ/לְ/הַחֲרִ֖ים רַבִּֽים

tokens.kjv: bruit, doctrine, fame, mentioned, news, report, rumor, tidings.

tokens.bdb: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously
tokens.kjv: be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.

tokens.bdb: properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as aquarter (gloomy and unknown)
to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, appear, [idiom] assuredly, bear out, [idiom] begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without), [phrase] be condemned, depart(-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, [idiom] scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, [idiom] still, [idiom] surely, take forth (out), at any time, [idiom] to (and fro), utter.
tokens.explanation: yatsa — sair, partir, nascer, brotar, emergir

tokens.bdb: heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever)
tokens.kjv: anger, bottles, hot displeasure, furious(-ly, -ry), heat, indignation, poison, rage, wrath(-ful). See H2529 (חֶמְאָה).

tokens.bdb: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, elder(-est), [phrase] exceeding(-ly), [phrase] far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, [idiom] sore, ([idiom]) very.
destory(-uction), bring to nought, overthrow, perish, pluck down, [idiom] utterly.

tokens.bdb: to seclude; specifically (by a ban) to devote to religious uses (especially destruction); physical and reflexive, to be blunt as to the nose
tokens.kjv: make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to seclude; specifically  to devote to religious uses ; physical and reflexive
tokens.enLiteralWord: to seclude; specifically  to devote to religious uses ; physical and reflexive
tokens.explanation: to seclude; specifically  to devote to religious uses ; physical and reflexive
tokens.explanationEn: to seclude; specifically  to devote to religious uses ; physical and reflexive

tokens.bdb: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
tokens.kjv: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).
tokens.explanation: rav — grande, muito, numeroso, abundante, ancião
